text_block_list.text: The day of Mayano Top Gun's debut race has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-chan!
Maya isn't wearing a jersey today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you know why~?
choice_data_list: Because I'm running in my debut race!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong, ding-dong, correct!
You get a gold star and Maya's top pick ◎!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And so~... Trainer-chan!
You can't take your eyes off Maya, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you watch Maya
sparkle and shine in the Twinkle Series, okay?♪
